comment: Sanctioned literal Cubism version sets in production sources. Every collection literal or file-level residual set of exact versions must be registered here with an audit basis and reason; unregistered sites fail checkVersionSetRegistry, and stale entries fail too. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/check_version_set_registry.py --update` and fill in the basis/reason of each new site.
